subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Permit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Permit"** means to give authorization or consent to someone to do something. (अनुमति देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The city council will **permit **the construction of the new park.
 
 
 
• **"Approve"** means to officially agree to or accept as satisfactory. (मंजूरी देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The manager will **approve **the budget proposal by the end of the day.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Approve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Flout** (उल्लंघन करना): To openly disregard a rule, law, or convention.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to flout the traffic rules and drove through the red light.
 
 
 
• **Abandon** (त्यागना): To give up completely or leave behind.
 
 
• **Example:** They had to abandon the project due to lack of funds.
 
 
 
• **Disgrace** (अपमान): Loss of reputation or respect as the result of a dishonorable action.
 
 
• **Example:** His unethical behavior brought disgrace to the entire family.
 
 

 

55:Tcb1,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
